core_obligations: Local-system bookkeeping on the regular part of M_0: take a stratum M_0(w)_(G-hat) and a point x in it; the author's decomposition of the top-degree homology of the fibre from the previous subsection is a decomposition of a g-module, and when the stratum is regular that homology is an irreducible integrable representation of g whose highest weight vector is the class of x, so every non-trivial local system contributes zero (proof lines 2734-2749).

The same statement on the other side: for a stratum M_{zeta^bullet}(w)_(H-hat) of the form Mreg_{zeta^bullet}(v^0,w) the top-degree homology of the fibre of pi_{zeta^bullet,zeta} is the irreducible integrable representation V^(g_I^0 + h)(w - v^0), with highest weight vector the class of y (proof lines 2751-2755).

Reduction to a product stratum: a stratum of M_{zeta^bullet}(w) containing a given IC sheaf can be written as the product of the regular part Mreg_{zeta^bullet}(v^0,w) with a stratum of M_0 for the subgraph I^0, and the commutative diagram of the author applies to it (proof lines 2757-2762).

Pushing forward through the finite birational morphism: since kappa is a finite birational morphism, the intersection cohomology of the closure of the product stratum is the pushforward of the exterior product, and the same for kappa-prime, so the pushforward contains only IC sheaves of non-regular strata unless the second factor is trivial (proof lines 2763-2776).

The final restriction identity and the identification of the multiplicities: substituting into the branching relation gives the restriction of V^g(w - v') as a direct sum over v^0 of the multiplicity space tensored with V^(g_I^0 + h)(w - v^0), and that multiplicity is by definition the space of homomorphisms from V^(g_I^0 + h)(w - v^0) to V^g(w - v'); the representations for different v^0 are non-isomorphic, which is the author's closing remark (proof lines 2777-2803).
proof_roadmap: 先在正则 strata 上把上一小节的分解读出：M_0 的正则 strata 上最高次同调是不可约可积表示、最高权向量是 x 的类，故非平凡局部系项为零；M_{zeta^bullet} 的正则 strata 上同理得到 V^(g_I^0+h)(w - v^0)。
再把含给定 IC 层的一般 strata 写成 Mreg_{zeta^bullet}(v^0,w) 与 M_0 上 strata 的乘积，用 kappa、kappa' 是有限双有理态射把 IC 的推前写成外积的推前，从而除第二因子平凡的情形外只剩非正则 strata 的 IC 层。
代入 branching 关系得到 Res V^g(w - v') 的分解，把重数认成 Hom 空间；最后用不同 v^0 对应的表示互不同构收尾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the branching theorem of the paper (author Theorem at source lines 2714-2731, label thm:branch): the pushforward of the intersection cohomology sheaf of the regular part of a quiver variety decomposes into a direct sum over v' of the Hom space between an irreducible integrable highest weight module of the Levi subalgebra and one of g, tensored with the IC sheaf of the regular part of M_0, plus IC sheaves of non-regular strata. The proof (source lines 2733-2803) is the paper's main technical argument: it first identifies the local-system decomposition of the top-degree homology of the fibre on the regular strata of both moduli spaces, using that the homology there is an irreducible integrable representation with a prescribed highest weight vector (proof lines 2734-2755), then rewrites an arbitrary stratum containing a given IC sheaf as a product stratum and pushes the exterior product through two finite birational morphisms, which is what forces all remaining summands to come from non-regular strata unless the second factor is trivial (proof lines 2757-2776), and finally reads off the restriction identity and identifies the multiplicities with the Hom spaces, using that the summands for different v^0 are non-isomorphic (proof lines 2777-2803). The argument is a chain rather than a single trick, and its middle step is the finite-birational-morphism computation. H2.
